notes.why_bitemporal: valid_time = when true in the world; ingestion_time = when the system learned it. Lets you answer 'what did we believe on date X' separately from 'what was actually true on date X' (matches Zep/TOKI bitemporal convention rather than inventing new terms).
notes.why_events_never_deleted: contradicted/superseded events stay in the graph with status flags, not deletions -- required for '20. Immediate Next Step' delayed-query reconstruction and for negative-knowledge queries ('was this ever discussed').
minimum_viable_slice_for_PoC: skip: multi-resolution compression, multi-agent sharing, feeling/subjective dimensions -- these are the highest-risk/lowest-payoff items per the doc's own §17
